mainEntity.name: What day is Petchyindee Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Petchyindee Muay Thai takes place on Thursday evenings at Rajadamnern Stadium in Bangkok.

mainEntity.name: What time does Petchyindee Muay Thai start?

acceptedAnswer.text: The event starts at 18:00. Doors open at 17:00.

mainEntity.name: What type of Muay Thai will I see?

acceptedAnswer.text: Petchyindee is built around technical competitive Muay Thai, with timing, balance, control, powerful kicks and clinching all forming part of the contests.

mainEntity.name: How many fights are on a Petchyindee card?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are between 9 and 11 bouts on a Petchyindee card, and it varies week by week.

mainEntity.name: Are all Petchyindee fights five rounds?
Is Petchyindee suitable for someone watching Muay Thai for the first time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A first-time visitor can follow the contest by watching how fighters use distance, balance and timing and how the pressure changes as each bout develops.

mainEntity.name: Can I arrive after the event has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Gates remain open all evening and guests can enter at their leisure.
